acceptance_criteria: The explicit segment map has exactly N=1600 boundary elements and a 2N=3200 BEM matrix.
All configured scan points and near-field rows are covered exactly once by config-hashed checkpoints before aggregation.
The maximum scattering linear residual is <=1e-9 and the median optical-theorem relative error is <=0.03.
The boundary resolution is b>=16 and the declared circular fillet satisfies the printed rho/lambda and rho/Delta-s ratios within 8%.
The reported resonance is sampled within 0.0025 kR, its finest-mesh boundary residual is <=5e-4, and the smallest singular value decreases from the coarsest mesh.
Near- and far-field arrays are finite and nonzero, while the far-field pi-rotation maximum error is <=1e-4.

The manifest records that no source pixels, author numerical arrays, or author code entered the numerical path; the mesh can satisfy the paper-declared equivalence class, while the prose/Figure 4 displacement-sign conflict keeps the publication-wide parameter state below unqualified paper-exact.
